'''Narell Balrekk''', also known as '''Balrekk the Butcher''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Stormtrooper]] [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Corps]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Balrekk served in the [[84th Stormtrooper Legion]] as the commander of [[Talon Company]], where he made a name for himself by using torture and other unsavory methods during interrogation of Rebel prisoners. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Balrekk and his company were sent to serve under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vorrel]] in an attack on a [[Arda Base|Rebel base]] built on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arda I]].<ref name="OoA1" />
